# Two clocks

`customer_support.mm.root_cause_analysis.two_clocks` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> There are two clocks: the ticket clock and the issue clock. A workaround stops the first and leaves the second running.

Almost every reporting pathology in support comes from an organisation with only one clock — it cannot express "resolved for the customer, unresolved in the product", so it reports the more comfortable of the two. This model is the reason resolution_delivery and root_cause_analysis are separate capabilities rather than one.
